description:
Spacious and recently renovated, this 6 bedroom, 6 bath duplex condo offers 4750 sq ft across the 9th and 10th floors of a boutique Upper East Side building. With ceilings over 9 ft, multiple exposures (south, north, and east), and a Poggenpohl chef’s kitchen with Viking appliances, the home combines comfort with modern convenience. description:
Newly renovated, sunflooded, pristine high floor, approx. 3,000 sq ft, 9 room residence offering 4-5 bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms, formal dining room and library/home office with expansive open views.

Enter through a gallery which takes you into an open living space, open kitchen, dining area with sun-filled Southern views. The windowed kitchen features new appliances including a SubZero refrigerator, 4-burner stove and Miele washer and dryer. The oversized primary bedroom suite has a large sitting area, a massive walk-in closet, separate cedar closet and custom built-ins along the windows with beautiful Eastern skyline views. The secondary bedrooms are all generous in size with open city views. There is a large private guest bedroom with an enormous closet and en-suite bathroom. There is also a separate wood paneled library, with double exposures and built-in bookcases, which is easily utilized as a wonderful home office/media combination.

Additional features of the apartment include new oak hardwood plank floors, through the wall A/C separately regulated in each room, custom lighting, electric shades and an abundance of storage and closets. A storage unit transfers with the apartment.

165 East 72nd Street is a full-service cooperative with 24-hour doormen, concierge, and live-in resident manager. Amenities include fitness center, bicycle room, central laundry rooms, private storage and a parking garage with access through the building. The building is very pet friendly and has 75% financing. Located in the heart of the Upper East Side, steps away from the East River or Central Park and near some of the finest restaurants and museums NYC has to offer.

heading: 28 Laight St, New York, NY 10013, USA
description:
28 Laight Street in Tribeca is the epitome of luxury living in the heart of New York City. This boutique condominium offers a distinctive blend of features and amenities that make it a standout choice for discerning residents.

Step inside the apartment, and you’ll be greeted by an abundance of space and elegance. With four bedrooms and three-and-a-half bathrooms, this 5400-square-foot apartment offers spacious comfort to its residents and flexibility for those who enjoy hosting guests. The dedicated laundry room further enhances your daily convenience.

The generously sized living and dining areas with a fireplace, coupled with a den /media room, ensure you have ample space for entertainment or relaxation. The wooden beam ceilings, stretching over ten feet high, not only add character but also bathe the space in natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

One of the remarkable perks of this condo is the included parking space, a precious commodity in the Tribeca neighborhood, where parking can be a challenge.

From the moment you arrive, the full-time doorman ensures a warm and secure welcome, while the dedicated full-time superintendent ensures that all your maintenance needs are promptly addressed.

There is a fully equipped gym that provides an ideal space to maintain your fitness routine. Meanwhile, the beautiful rooftop deck offers a serene retreat with breathtaking skyline views, perfect for unwinding or hosting gatherings.

The convenient location makes daily errands and commuting a breeze. Nearby the 1 Local train at Broadway and the 2 Express train at Canal. Plus, the condo is surrounded by green spaces like St. John’s Park, Duarte Square, and Grand Canal Court, providing a refreshing contrast to city life.

In summary, 28 Laight Street in Tribeca offers not just a home, but a lifestyle that combines luxury, convenience, and the vibrant energy of one of New York City’s most sought-after neighborhoods.

heading: E 68th St, New York, NY, USA
description: Manhattan sophistication at its finest. This custom duplex inside a mansion is the perfect marriage of old world elegance and modern convenience awaits in this sophisticated three-bedroom, three-and-a half bathroom 2,715 square foot duplex situated in a landmarked, 25’ limestone mansion on the “Gold Coast” of the Upper East Side. The extravagant, sun-filled duplex is replete with custom details, a keyed elevator opens directly into a mahogany paneled grand foyer, leading to the sun kissed, south-facing expansive living room showcasing nearly floor-to-ceiling windows with Juliet balconies, a marble wood-burning fireplace, and an adjoining bar with a Subzero wine cooler and undercounter refrigerated drawers. A charming, windowed media alcove with a custom built-in entertainment center separates the two winged bedrooms on this level. The luxurious master suite hosts its own wood burning fireplace and massive custom walk-in closet by Ornare. This closet leads to a state-of-the-art, five-piece marble bathroom fitted with a jacuzzi tub, spa-style steam shower for two, clever vanity with a mirrored TV, radiant heated floor, and exquisite dual sinks. Gorgeous mahogany bookcase doors open to the spacious second bedroom, which offers an en-suite bathroom with a deep soaking tub. Up the gorgeously detailed mahogany staircase is a light-filled formal dining room featuring a limestone wood burning fireplace with an adjacent full bathroom, home office, laundry room, and spacious third bedroom with custom millwork. The other side of the dining room opens into a spectacular windowed, sun drenched chef’s kitchen featuring custom cabinetry, stone counters, radiant heated floor and appliances by Sub Zero, Miele, Gaggenau, and Thermador including a six burner cooktop, grill top, double oven, warming drawer, and trash compactor. Beautiful mahogany millwork, detailed coffered ceilings, graceful crown molding, recessed lighting, central air, and a Crestron control system are throughout. The Dunham House is an eight unit cooperative steps from Central Park nestled between Park and Madison Avenues in one of the most coveted neighborhoods in the world. This prime location offers convenient access to museums and a plethora of the finest restaurants and shops in New York City. The 6 train is one block away. This stunning mansion was built in 1899 by Carrere & Hastings, the same architectural firm that designed The Frick Collection and The NY Public Library. Apartment Features: East exposure, North exposure, South exposure, West exposure, Wood-burning fireplace, Balcony – juliet, Partial city view, Prewar detail, Floors – hardwood, Light – excellent, Windows – oversized, Windows – new, Modern kitchen, Renovated bathroom, Marble bath, Storage space, Walk in closets, Great closet space, Washer/dryer, Dishwasher, Security system Building Features: Roof deck, Private storage. This residence is an experience; the perfect combination of classic beauty and contemporary living.

description: This beautiful home in West Hampton Beach is a serene retreat with over 3000 square feet to enjoy. The open floor plan in this home provides you with comfortable living. Enter the living room/dining area which is adorned with a beautiful working stone fireplace. The windowed pass through gourmet kitchen has a skylight and stainless steel appliances. Just off the kitchen is a lovely TV room with another skylight and over-sized windows allowing tons of natural light to flow in. The lay out of this home is perfect for entertaining. The home also has four bedrooms and three bathrooms. The large master bedroom has double closets adorned with French doors and its own master bathroom. There are three other guest and/or children bedrooms, two other full bathrooms and a laundry room. The elegant, landscaped property set on a 0.44 acre lot is fenced in, has an extended driveway and is also lined by hedges for additional privacy. The backyard has an enclosed, heated pool with electric solar pool cover, hot outdoor shower, swing set, and stone patio great for barbecues. One of the best things about this property is the location. It is just south of Montauk Highway and within walking distance from the synagogue. You can walk down the street to the school, park, tennis, baseball and basketball courts and track. You can also enjoy a scenic 10 minute walk to/from the Long Island Railroad, 10 minute walk to Westhampton town center and a 15 minute bike ride the beach.
